ferrovoz.notice.server_newer_legacy: This server uses a newer Ferrovoz (protocol %1$s) than yours (%2$s). Update the mod to get voice chat here.

ferrovoz.notice.mic_blocked_mac: Your microphone is only sending silence: macOS isn't letting Minecraft use it. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, enable your launcher (Minecraft, Prism, Modrinth, CurseForge…) and restart the game. If it isn't listed, open the launcher from Terminal once so macOS asks.
ferrovoz.notice.mic_blocked: Your microphone is only sending silence. Check it isn't muted (headset button or system) and that the system lets Minecraft use it, or pick another one in Voice settings (J).
ferrovoz.settings.status.mic_blocked_mac: Mic input is silent: allow it in System Settings → Privacy → Microphone
ferrovoz.settings.status.mic_blocked: Mic input is silent: is it muted or blocked by the system?
